note: Supplementary baselines and stability checks referenced in REPORT.md narrative but computed as ad-hoc queries rather than dedicated scripts.

test_period_coin_returns_2026_08_13_to_0.units: pct return over the 16-day TEST window, all 12 coins positive -- an exceptional broad rally that structurally favors any long-biased (buy-side) fade rule tested in this report

baseline_unconditional_test_period_dir_m.note: ANY wallet selling during the test window shows negative markout on average, purely from the broad rally -- context for interpreting M3/M7/M14's 'fade the sell' gross numbers

baseline_eligible_noncohort_sellers_m3_t.note: population baseline used for M3's excess-over-baseline calc: same n_train>=30 eligibility filter, excluding the top5% timing cohort

m3_top5pct_timing_cohort_excess_over_pop.note: cohort raw minus population baseline (dir=-1 only) -- the better-controlled estimate of genuine wallet-selection alpha net of common market drift; fade edge = negative of these (still positive and economically the most defensible number for M3)

m14a_funding_gt0_dir_minus1_half_split_s.note: NOT stable at 60s (sign flips h1->h2); same-sign but decays ~3x at 300s. Confirms this number is dominated by a transient regime effect, not tested for stability in the original M14 script due to time constraints -- added here before finalizing verdict.

m14b_oi_rising_dir_minus1_half_split_sta.note: Same-sign both halves but decays ~5-23x from h1 to h2 -- the single largest raw gross number in the whole sweep is also the LEAST stable, consistent with a one-off regime/period effect rather than a persistent mechanism.
